claim_title: Distinct Formation Windows for Personal vs Attributed Belief in Pythia-1B Pretraining

figures.caption: Formation windows for personal vs attributed belief on pythia-1b. Attributed behaviour is above 60% at initialization (prompt-structure bias) but its causal circuit only emerges at step 33000; personal-belief behaviour and its causal circuit both crystallize together at step 13000. Distinct=TRUE. Coarse-log-spaced resolution reflects the 24 checkpoints available on disk (of 154 planned).
